paragraphs: In [Berakhot 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22a.9) and [Avodah Zarah 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.34b.2) he speaks in the name of Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel. It appears that he is Rabbi Yehudah Nesiah [א)]; see his entry. Hyman reports that [Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.12), counts him among Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's generation.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman tentatively identifies him with Rabbi Yehudah Nesiah. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1637&lang=en) calls the transmitter Yehudah ben Gamliel of Yavneh.
The Oxford text of the Epistle lists Yehudah ben Gamla immediately after Chanina ben Gamliel. Hyman gives the former as Yehudah ben Gamliel in this entry.
